correctness.assertion: every cycle joined every owned task
every cycle performed the same repository work
every cycle failed, restarted, and reached the same durable observation
every restart re-ran only the partition that had failed

notes: Each cycle builds its own repository, so resident growth across cycles measures process-level retention rather than a growing history. A restart inside every cycle proves completed partitions are reused rather than rerun.
summary: Repeated launch, drain, restart, and recovery cycles with resource growth
